5.6.9 Rte_SwitchAck Purpose: Provide access to mode switch completed acknowledgements and error notifications to mode managers. Signature: [SWS_Rte_02725] Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00310, SRS_Rte_00122 ⌈ Std_ReturnType Rte_[Byps_]SwitchAck_

_( [IN Rte_Instance ]) Where

is the port name and the ModeDeclara- tionGroupPrototype within the ModeSwitchInterface cate- gorizing the port. [Byps_] is an optional infix used when compo- nent wrapper method for bypass support is enabled for the related software component type.⌋ Existence: [SWS_Rte_02676] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00051, SRS_Rte_00122 ⌈Acknowledgement is enabled for a provided ModeDeclara- tionGroupPrototype by the existence of a ModeSwitchedAck- Request in the ModeSwitchSenderComSpec.⌋ [SWS_Rte_02677] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00051, SRS_Rte_00122 ⌈A blocking Rte_SwitchAck API shall be generated for a pro- vided ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype if acknowledgement is enabled and a WaitPoint references a ModeSwitchedAckEvent that in turn references the ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype.⌋ [SWS_Rte_07846] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00122, SRS_Rte_00092 ⌈A blocking Rte_SwitchAck API shall block when a mode switch in the related mode machine instance is ongoing.⌋ [SWS_Rte_07847] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00122, SRS_Rte_00092, SRS_Rte_ 00139 ⌈A blocking Rte_SwitchAck API shall return: • if the mode machine instance behaves as unconnected or • if the calling runnable runs in an exclusive area or • if no mode switch in the related mode machine instance is on- going or • when the wait point timeout occurs or • when the related ModeSwitchedAckEvent is triggered. ⌋ [SWS_Rte_02678] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00051, SRS_Rte_00122 ⌈A non-blocking Rte_SwitchAck API shall be generated for a pro- vided ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype if acknowledgement is enabled but no WaitPoint references a ModeSwitchedAckEvent that references the ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype.
